verdict.rationale: IRN Empresa Online is a government web service for incorporating companies: form-based filing, digital signature, payment and registration. Plugging in MCP servers so the product can use their tools is an AI-agent client capability, which is a category error for a non-agentic public e-service portal. Nothing in the evidence shows the product embeds an agent or consumes external tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
